post.description: Login a user with email and password

get.description: Check if the API is running

delete.description: Anyone in the project. Its comments and activity trail go with it; setting the status to cancelled instead keeps the history.

patch.description: Fields left out of the payload are unchanged. Every change is recorded on the issue's activity trail.

get.description: Append-only record of everything that has happened to the issue, oldest first. The payload's shape depends on the entry's type, e.g. {"from":"todo","to":"done"} for status_changed.

post.description: The user must already be a member of the project. An issue may have any number of assignees.
post.summary: Assign a user to an issue

delete.summary: Unassign a user from an issue

get.description: Comments are returned newest first, each with a summary of its author.

post.summary: Post a comment on an issue

delete.description: Only the comment's author or a project admin may delete it.

patch.description: Only the comment's author or a project admin may edit it.

post.description: Anyone in the project. The label must belong to the issue's project (422 otherwise). Applying a label the issue already has changes nothing and returns 200.
post.summary: Apply a label to an issue

delete.summary: Remove a label from an issue

get.description: Return the user identified by the auth cookie or bearer token

post.description: Requires the current password. Clears must_change_password

get.description: The superadmin gets every project; everyone else gets the ones they belong to. Each project has my_role, the caller's role in it.
get.summary: List the projects the caller can see

post.description: Admins and the superadmin only. The creator becomes the project's first admin.

get.description: Includes each member's role, and my_access, which tells the caller which actions to offer.
get.summary: Get a project with its members

put.description: Project admins and the superadmin only. Partial update; omitted fields keep their current value.

delete.description: Project admins and the superadmin only.

get.description: Comments are returned newest first, each with a summary of its creator.

post.summary: Post a comment on a project

delete.description: Only the comment's author or a project admin may delete it.

patch.description: Only the comment's author or a project admin may edit it.

get.description: Latest start first. Each cycle has its status (upcoming, active, overdue, completed; worked out in APP_TIMEZONE) and issue counts per issue status. Filter with ?status=.

post.description: Anyone in the project, while cycles are on (409 otherwise). Dates are inclusive and may not overlap another cycle in the project (422).

put.description: Project admins and the superadmin only. Turning cycles off is refused (422) while the project has an uncompleted cycle.
put.summary: Turn cycles on or off for a project

get.description: Includes its status and issue counts per issue status, for progress.

delete.description: Anyone in the project, while cycles are on. Its issues stay, with no cycle.

patch.description: Anyone in the project, while cycles are on. Fields left out are unchanged. A completed cycle is read-only (422).

post.description: Anyone in the project, while cycles are on. In one transaction: the cycle is marked completed, and its issues that aren't done or cancelled move to move_open_issues_to (another uncompleted cycle in the project) or to no cycle. Each moved issue gets a cycle_changed activity.

get.description: Issues are returned newest first, each with its assignees and labels.

post.description: Omitting status or priority falls back to 'backlog' and 'no-priority'. label_ids must all belong to the project, or nothing is created (422).
post.summary: Create an issue on a project

get.description: Sorted by name. Anyone in the project may read them.

post.description: Project admins and the superadmin only. Names are unique within the project, ignoring case. Color is a hex value like #e11d48.
post.summary: Create a label on a project

delete.description: Project admins and the superadmin only. The label comes off every issue; their activity keeps a snapshot of it. The response says how many issues had it.

patch.description: Project admins and the superadmin only. Fields left out are unchanged. Issues' past activity keeps the name and color the label had then.

post.description: Project admins and the superadmin only. Role is admin or contributor, and defaults to contributor.
post.summary: Add a member to a project

delete.description: Project admins and the superadmin only. The member is unassigned from every issue in the project. Removing the last admin returns 422.
delete.summary: Remove a member from a project

patch.description: Project admins and the superadmin only. A project always keeps at least one admin, so demoting the last one returns 422.

get.description: Report whether the install still needs its superadmin created

post.description: Create the superadmin account. Only works once: after that it returns 409

get.description: Users, oldest first. Filter with active=true|false; omit it for both. Anyone logged in can list active users (project admins need it to add people); only admins and the superadmin see deactivated ones, so for everyone else the filter is always active=true

parameters.description: Only active (true) or only deactivated (false) users
parameters.name: active

post.description: Create an admin or member. Admins may only create members (403 otherwise). The new user must change the password on first login

patch.description: Change name and/or role (admin or member). Admins may only rename members; changing a role is superadmin-only. The superadmin's role can't be changed here

post.description: The user can no longer log in. Their history, memberships, project roles and assignments stay. You can't deactivate yourself, and admins may only deactivate members. orphaned_projects lists the projects where they were the only active project admin
Superadmin only. The target, who must be active, becomes the superadmin and the caller becomes an admin
Set a temporary password. The user must change it on their next login. Admins may only reset members' passwords

move_open_issues_to.description:
MoveOpenIssuesTo is another uncompleted cycle in the project, or null (or
left out) to leave open issues with no cycle.

label_ids.description: LabelIDs are applied in the same transaction; each must belong to the project.

cycle_id.description: CycleID moves the issue into a cycle, or out of one with null.

issue_counts.description:
IssueCounts maps each issue status to how many of the cycle's issues have
it, for progress. Statuses with no issues are absent.

status.description:
Status depends on today's date, so it's worked out per request (see
SetStatus) rather than stored.

cycles_enabled.description: CyclesEnabled is changed only through SetCyclesEnabled, never Update.
CyclesEnabled is changed only through SetCyclesEnabled, never Update.

BearerAuth.description: JWT from POST /auth/login. Paste it with the scheme included, e.g. "Bearer eyJhbGciOi..."
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
